title: Breaa Tankless Electric Water Heater
subtitle: 5500 W White
category: Home Appliances > Water Heaters / Geyser > Tankless Water Heater
key_features: LED Digital Temperature Display: A minimalist display gives the accurate temperature of the water. It allows to set the temperature of water to your comfort level.
Feather touch panel: The feather touch control panel allows easy access to the temperature setting.
Digital Temperature setting: Allows you to set the temperature of water to your comfort level
Anti Scald: The Set Temperature is maintained throughout the operation to ensure user don’t get scald by very hot water.
Overheat Protection: If the outlet water temperature rises beyond 60 °C, the overheat protection function shuts of the product instantly & displays the error code to warn the users.
Dry heat Protection: Dry heating protection through water flow sensor. If there is no flow of water, the product will not operate and will displays the error code to warn the user.

Energy Saving through smart adjustment: The tankless water heater adjusts power input based on water flow rate and temperature setting in real time. For example: less power will be consumed by the unit when water flow is reduced.
